description: North Island 10m Pre-Cyclone Gabrielle Satellite Imagery (2022) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by National Imagery. This imagery was captured by the European Space Agency Sentinel-2 satellites on the 22nd November 2022 NZT. Published here as a part of the response to the severe weather emergency event in February 2023 as a record of the Hawke's Bay and Gisborne regions prior to Cyclone Gabrielle in February 2023. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher National Imagery. Its tags are imageryBaseMapsEarthCover. It offers 1 resource(s) in raster. The portal shows 2026-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
